nodes.instruction: Build and upgrade all four elemental staffs: Wind, Ice, Lightning, and Fire. Activate all six generators as required by the stock objective.

items.label: Wind part · Thor
items.location: Inside Thor, walking near Generators 2/3; enter through lit foot.

items.label: Wind part · Odin
items.location: Inside Odin, walking near Generators 4/5; enter through lit foot.

items.label: Wind part · Freya
items.location: Inside Freya, by Generator 6/Church; enter through lit foot.

items.label: Yellow disc
items.location: Generator 5 area: table by Lightning Tunnel, outside boxes, or wall near Stamin-Up.

items.label: Wind crystal
items.location: Wind podium in Crazy Place; open Wind Tunnel near Generator 4 with Gramophone.

items.label: Ice part · Gens 2/3
items.location: Snowing rounds; shovel-dig sites around Generators 2/3.

items.label: Ice part · Gens 4/5
items.location: Snowing rounds; shovel-dig sites around Generators 4/5.

items.label: Ice part · Church/Gen 6
items.location: Snowing rounds; shovel-dig sites by Church and Generator 6.

items.label: Blue disc
items.location: Generator 2: back entrance shelf, shelf beside Mystery Box, or entrance table.

items.label: Ice crystal
items.location: Ice podium in Crazy Place; open Ice Tunnel at Generator 6 with Gramophone.

items.label: Lightning part · tank 1
items.location: Jump from tank at wooden stairs on route to Generator 2.

items.label: Lightning part · tank 2
items.location: Jump from tank at giant footprint.

items.label: Lightning part · tank 3
items.location: Jump from tank at scaffolding between Excavation and Church.

items.label: Purple disc
items.location: Generator 4: chariot, Wunderfizz-side table, or engine by Wind Tunnel.

items.label: Lightning crystal
items.location: Lightning podium in Crazy Place; open Lightning Tunnel near Generator 5.

items.label: Fire part · plane
items.location: Shoot glowing plane with bullet weapon; collect drop near Excavation.

items.label: Fire part · Panzer
items.location: Kill first Panzersoldat; collect drop.

items.label: Fire part · Generator 6
items.location: Generator 6 reward chest beside generator.

items.label: Red disc
items.location: Church/Gen 6: upper benches, box by Gen 6 sign, or boxes near tank/stairs.

items.label: Fire crystal
items.location: Fire podium in Crazy Place; open Fire Tunnel between Spawn and Generator 3.

items.label: Black disc
items.location: Excavation Site: engine by ramp, stone beside Church path, or wheelbarrow by Pack-a-Punch.

items.label: Gramophone
items.location: Hall of Ancients floor beside wooden table.

items.label: Shovel
items.location: Spawn room; needed for Ice staff.

items.label: Build four staffs
items.location: Hall of Ancients pedestals below Excavation.

items.label: Upgrade four staffs
items.location: Complete each Crazy Place puzzle and map task; upgrade at Excavation.

nodes.detection: Stock ee_all_staffs_crafted flag.

nodes.title: Secure the keys
nodes.instruction: Upgrade all four staffs, then place them in their matching pedestals in the giant robots and Excavation Site. Keep all six generators active.

items.label: Wind staff
items.location: Odin head (middle giant).

items.label: Ice staff
items.location: Freya head (Church giant).

items.label: Lightning staff
items.location: Thor head (Spawn giant).

items.label: Fire staff
items.location: Hall of the Ancients beneath Excavation Site.

nodes.detection: Observed from the stock Little Lost Girl step counter; final completion uses Samantha released.

nodes.title: Ascend from darkness
nodes.instruction: Use G-Strikes to break the seal near Generator 5. Coordinate the Giant alarm and the timed throw.

items.label: Stone tablet
items.location: Table by back entrance at Generator 2.

items.label: Clean tablet
items.location: Church upper-floor basin by window; get melee kills, return without touching mud.

items.label: Claim G-Strike
items.location: Return tablet to Generator 2 table, get more melee kills, then pick up reward.

nodes.detection: Observed from the stock Little Lost Girl step counter; final completion uses Samantha released.

nodes.title: Rain fire
nodes.instruction: Send the Maxis Drone through the broken seal and defeat the released Panzersoldat.

checklists.title: Maxis Drone · assemble at any workbench

items.label: Brain
items.location: Starting Spawn table.

items.label: Rotor
items.location: Excavation: corner left of Pack-a-Punch, corner by Gramophone spawn, or crate beside lantern on wooden platform.

items.label: Frame
items.location: Either mud path from Church, or beside engine at bottom of Ice Tunnel.

items.label: Build drone
items.location: Any workbench.

nodes.detection: Observed from the stock Little Lost Girl step counter; final completion uses Samantha released.

nodes.title: Unleash the horde
nodes.instruction: While Zombie Blood is active, shoot down the glowing plane, find and kill its pilot, then recover the Maxis Drone.

items.label: Maxis Drone
items.location: Build at any workbench from the Spawn Brain, Excavation rotor, and Church mud-path/Ice Tunnel frame.

nodes.detection: Observed from the stock Little Lost Girl step counter; final completion uses Samantha released.

nodes.title: Skewer the winged beast
nodes.instruction: Fill all four footprint soul chests to earn the One-Inch Punch. Use it on the marked Templar zombies, then collect the stone tablet to upgrade it to the Fist of Iron. Every player must finish this objective.

checklists.title: One-Inch Punch · all four giant-footprint soul chests

items.label: Chest 1
items.location: Odin right footprint near Generator 4.

items.label: Chest 2
items.location: Odin right footprint near Generator 5.

items.label: Chest 3
items.location: Freya left footprint near Church.

items.label: Chest 4
items.location: Odin left footprint near Excavation.

items.label: Claim One-Inch Punch
items.location: Reward chest at Spawn or Generator 6.

items.label: Upgrade to Fist of Iron
items.location: Church tablet and melee kills on marked Templar Zombies; every player completes their own.

nodes.detection: Observed from the stock Little Lost Girl step counter; final completion uses Samantha released.

playerCountGuidance.instruction: For 5+ players, the mod spawns extra muddy stone-tablet rewards beside the challenge boxes so players can each obtain the One-Inch Punch and finish this step.

nodes.title: Fist of iron
nodes.instruction: Place all four staffs in the Crazy Place pedestals and kill zombies to open the rift to Agartha.
nodes.detection: Observed from the stock Little Lost Girl step counter; final completion uses Samantha released.

items.label: Return four staffs
items.location: Place the Wind, Ice, Lightning, and Fire staffs in their matching Crazy Place pedestals.

items.label: Fill pedestal souls
items.location: Kill zombies near the four pedestals until the rift opens.

nodes.title: Raise hell
nodes.instruction: Activate the Maxis Drone in the Crazy Place rift, then have every player stand on the central plate and interact to start the ending.

items.label: Maxis Drone
items.location: Build at any workbench from the Spawn Brain, Excavation rotor, and Church mud-path/Ice Tunnel frame.

nodes.detection: Observed from the stock Little Lost Girl step counter; final completion uses Samantha released.

nodes.title: Freedom
nodes.instruction: The final interaction completes Little Lost Girl; confirm Samantha is released and the stock quest completion signal is observed.
nodes.detection: Observed from the stock Little Lost Girl step counter; final completion uses Samantha released.

items.label: Samantha released
items.location: After the Crazy Place ending sequence completes, wait for the release confirmation.
